questions.stem: It is hypothesized that grandmothers spend more hours per week on FaceTime with their grandchildren than do grandfathers. A random sample of 100 couples who have at least one grandchild are interviewed, and a two-sample t-test is performed. Have all conditions for inference been met?
questions.answer_text: Since couples are chosen, the samples of grandmothers and grandfathers are not independent, so a two-sample t-test cannot be performed. If the procedure would be to perform a one-sample t-test on the set of differences, then the conditions for inference would be met. Random assignment does not make sense here. The sample size, n = 100, is large enough for the central limit theorem to apply, so the population distribution need not be approximately normal. One hundred grandparents is clearly less than 10% of all grandparents.

options.C: A two-sample t-test for a difference between sample means
options.D: A two-sample t-test for a difference between population means

questions.stem: Head injuries are a major concern in the sport of football. Five hundred D-1 football players were randomly picked. Half were randomly assigned to wear helmets based on foam padding. The other half were randomly assigned to wear helmets using padding that was custom 3D-printed to the shape of their heads. The helmets were used for an entire season including practices, preseason games, and regular season games. The mean number of head injuries was recorded for each group. Which of the following is an appropriate inference procedure for analyzing the results of the investigation?
questions.answer_text: There were two independent groups, and the data were collected on a single quantitative variable (number of head injuries). The correct procedure is a two-sample t-test for a difference in population means.

questions.stem: Do high school girls apply to more colleges than high school boys? A two-sample t-test of the hypotheses results in a p-value of 0.02. Which of the following statements must be true? I. A 90% confidence interval for the difference in means contains 0. II. A 95% confidence interval for the difference in means contains 0. III. A 99% confidence interval for the difference in means contains 0.
questions.answer_text: With 0.02 in the tail, a confidence interval over 0.48 + 0.48 = 0.96 = 96% will contain 0.

questions.stem: Bisphenol A (BPA), a synthetic estrogen found in packaging materials, has been shown to leach into infant formula and beverages.
